sn35.167:1.3: kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
sn35.167:1.4: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.167:1.5: rūpe anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.167:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.167:1.7: cakkhusamphassaṃ anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.167:1.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati …pe…
sn35.167:1.9: jivhaṃ anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati …pe…
sn35.167:1.10: manaṃ anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.167:1.14: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato attānudiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
